Name: BackupDirectory
Description: Backup directory for LAPS passwords (1=Azure AD, 2=Active Directory)

Name: PasswordLength
Description: Minimum password length for managed accounts

Name: PasswordAgeDays
Description: Maximum password age in days before automatic rotation

Name: PostAuthenticationActions
Description: Post-authentication actions (3=Reset password, logoff, and restart managed account)

Name: PostAuthenticationResetDelay
Description: Delay in hours before post-authentication password reset

Name: ADPasswordEncryptionEnabled
Description: Enable encryption of LAPS passwords stored in Active Directory

Name: ADBackupDSRMPassword
Description: Backup DSRM password to Active Directory (0=Disabled)

Name: AutomaticAccountManagementEnabled
Description: Enable automatic management of the local administrator account

Name: AutomaticAccountManagementRandomizePassword
Description: Randomize password for automatically managed accounts
